_note: Family wishes videos. Put video files in assets/videos/wishes/ and add one entry per video, for example: {"id":"wish-1","title":"From Vikky","from":"Vikky","src":"assets/videos/wishes/vikky.mp4","poster":"assets/videos/wishes/vikky.jpg","captions":""}. 'poster' and 'captions' (.vtt) are optional. With an empty list, the section shows a graceful 'on their way' message.
